stage: Original Task28 — full local ionic block under imposed voltage and calcium
input_contract: Imposed V in mV, imposed cai in mM, all 18 gate states and dt in ms; fixed canonical 34C where NMODL specifies q10. No model-generated calcium, voltage or events.
current_contract: Eleven analytic conductance currents in mA/cm2, never a learned current head. Five-channel learned rates only; six remaining channels use canonical equations. Sum currents with signed inward-negative convention. Ionic reversals and gbar are explicit per panel, never inferred from teacher output.
selection: No retraining and no selection on development or fresh. Evaluate all four frozen Task27 models. Development is a technical preflight only. Each seed, channel, panel and path is reported; no cross-channel averaging can hide failure.
promotion: Task28 ionic teacher-forced composition passes only when all eleven canonical reference mechanisms pass their required native/formula audits and both frozen both-arm families pass every fresh seed, current panel and imposed path threshold. Gate D additionally requires at least 10% measured same-device material compute reduction, no important-current regression and attributable per-channel errors. A Task28 pass alone never authorizes autonomous voltage or calcium feedback.
limits: Hybrid exact/learned local ion block at imposed V and cai; no CaDynamics_E2, passive membrane, axial solve, synapses, model-generated calcium, closed-loop voltage or full-neuron speed claim. Formula channels remain canonical rather than learned; this must be explicit in any result.
